literature.headline_zh: 人腺病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期人腺病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 在68,004名接受呼吸道样本检测的儿童中,有4,292名(6.3%)检测出HAdV,其中1,779名(41.4%)为HAdV单检测。与HAdV单检测相比,HAdV与人鼻病毒/肠病毒(HRV/EV)(43.1%)、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)(14.7%)和副流感病毒(PIV)(7.6%)的联合检测与住院和住院期间吸氧的几率增加有关。然而,HRV/EV、RSV和PIV单检测的住院和住院期间吸氧几率也比HAdV单检测时更高。 [10.1093/jpids/piag070/piag070.012]
第 7 天时,与其他组相比,第 3 组在异物感 (P = 0.013)、疼痛 (P = 0.019) 和结膜充血 (P = 0.00) 方面表现出明显更好的结果。第 7 天时,对照组的上皮下浸润 (SEI) (P = 0.0001) 和假膜 (P = 0.035) 数量显着高于其他组。所有组的病毒载量减少情况各不相同,并且无法建立相关性。 [10.4103/ijo.ijo_1019_25]
E1a基因阳性粪便样本的比例在小家鼠中为6.7%,在褐家鼠中为35%。系统发育和单倍型分析将这些序列归入AdV36簇,并显示与人类AdV36序列共享相同的病毒单倍型。 [10.1098/rsos.261285]
研究发现病毒性结膜炎占大多数病例,其中腺病毒是重要贡献者。腺病毒可在污染物上存活数周,结合无症状前期排毒与低感染剂量,促进了社区的快速传播。 [10.1007/s10792-026-04238-w]
HAdV-C5与IAV H1N1类似,在感染过程中以时间依赖性方式诱导脂质过氧化,这种效应在存在铁死亡抑制剂ferrostatin-1的情况下部分被抑制。此外,HAdV-C5感染在感染晚期导致铁蛋白蛋白水平的变化,而两种病毒均在不同细胞类型和感染阶段引发线粒体网络重塑。 [10.1128/spectrum.01957-26]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: Of 68,004 children enrolled with a respiratory specimen tested, 4,292 (6.3%) were positive for HAdV; 1,779 (41.4%) of these were HAdV single detections. HAdV co-detection with HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV was associated with increased odds of hospitalization and in-hospital oxygen use when compared to HAdV single detection. [10.1093/jpids/piag070/piag070.012]

Group 3 showed significantly better outcomes in terms of foreign body sensation (P = 0.013), pain (P = 0.019), and conjunctival congestion (P = 0.00) compared to other groups at day 7. [10.4103/ijo.ijo_1019_25]

The proportion of faecal samples positive for the AdV36 E1a gene was 6.7% in Mus musculus and 35% in Rattus norvegicus. Phylogenetic and haplotype analyses grouped these sequences within the AdV36 cluster and showed shared viral haplotypes with human AdV36 sequences. [10.1098/rsos.261285]

The study found that viral conjunctivitis accounts for the majority of cases, with adenovirus being a significant contributor. Adenovirus's ability to survive on fomites for weeks, combined with pre-symptomatic shedding and low infectious dose, facilitates rapid community spread. [10.1007/s10792-026-04238-w]
HAdV-C5, like IAV H1N1, induces lipid peroxidation in a time-dependent manner, which is partially suppressed by the ferroptosis inhibitor ferrostatin-1. [10.1128/spectrum.01957-26]

papers.title: A prospective, randomized study comparing different therapeutic modalities for acute adenoviral conjunctivitis
papers.abstract: Purpose: To compare the outcomes of three different therapeutic modalities in acute adenoviral conjunctivitis. Design: Prospective randomized study. Methods: A total of 65 eyes of 65 patients with nested polymerase chain reaction (PCR)-proven adenoviral conjunctivitis were enrolled. The control group (20 eyes) received carbomer gel, whereas the treatment group (15 eyes each) received group 1: Ganciclovir (0.15%) gel five times/day and dexamethasone 0.1% four times/day; group 2: Povidone–iodine (PVP-I) 1% four times/day, and dexamethasone 0.1% four times/day; group 3: PVP-I 1% four times/day, ganciclovir 0.15% five times/day, and dexamethasone 0.1% four times/day in addition to the standard of care. Patients presenting within the first 96 hours were recruited, and antiviral treatment was given for seven days in all groups. The clinical signs and symptoms, as well as the viral load, were documented at enrollment, day 7, and day 14. All the symptoms and signs were graded. Results: Group 3 performed significantly better in terms of foreign body sensation ( P = 0.013), pain ( P = 0.019), and conjunctival congestion ( P = 0.00) compared with all the groups at day 7. The control group had a significantly higher number of subepithelial infiltrates (SEIs) ( P = 0.0001) and pseudomembranes ( P = 0.035) at day 7 than all the other groups. The viral load reduction was variable in all patients in all the groups; thus, a correlation could not be achieved. Conclusion: The combination of PVP-I 1% and ganciclovir 0.15% with dexamethasone 0.1% significantly reduced the severity of signs and symptoms in adenoviral conjunctivitis. The addition of dexamethasone was safe and effective in decreasing the incidence of SEI’s and pseudomembranes.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to compare the outcomes of three different therapeutic modalities in acute adenoviral conjunctivitis, addressing the need for effective treatment strategies in managing this condition.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A prospective randomized study was conducted involving 65 eyes of 65 patients with adenoviral conjunctivitis confirmed by nested PCR. Patients were recruited within the first 96 hours of symptom onset.
analysis.methods: Clinical signs and symptoms, as well as viral load, were documented at enrollment, day 7, and day 14. All symptoms and signs were graded systematically.
analysis.main_results: Group 3 showed significantly better outcomes in terms of foreign body sensation (P = 0.013), pain (P = 0.019), and conjunctival congestion (P = 0.00) compared to other groups at day 7. The control group had a significantly higher number of subepithelial infiltrates (SEIs) (P = 0.0001) and pseudomembranes (P = 0.035) at day 7 than the other groups. Viral load reduction was variable across all groups, and no correlation could be established.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that the combination of PVP-I 1% and ganciclovir 0.15% with dexamethasone 0.1% significantly reduced the severity of signs and symptoms in adenoviral conjunctivitis. They also noted that the addition of dexamethasone was safe and effective in decreasing the incidence of SEIs and pseudomembranes.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings may inform the development of more effective treatment protocols for adenoviral conjunctivitis, particularly in managing symptoms and preventing complications such as SEIs and pseudomembranes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study had a small sample size, and the viral load reduction was variable, making it difficult to establish a clear correlation. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This prospective, randomized study evaluated three therapeutic modalities for acute adenoviral conjunctivitis. The control group received carbomer gel, while treatment groups combined antiviral and corticosteroid agents. Group 3, which included PVP-I 1%, ganciclovir 0.15%, and dexamethasone 0.1%, showed significantly better symptom improvement compared to other groups at day 7. The control group had higher rates of subepithelial infiltrates and pseudomembranes. Viral load reduction was inconsistent across all groups, and no correlation was found. The authors concluded that the combination therapy was effective in reducing symptom severity and that dexamethasone was safe and effective in preventing complications. The study's small sample size and variable viral load reduction limit the strength of the evidence, which is assessed as moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在比较急性腺病毒结膜炎的三种不同治疗方式的结果,解决治疗这种疾病的有效 治疗 策略的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项前瞻性随机研究,纳入65例经巢式PCR确诊的腺病毒性结膜炎患者(65只眼)。患者在症状出现后96小时内入组。
elements_zh.methods: 在入组时、第 7 天和第 14 天记录临床体征和症状以及病毒载量。所有症状和体征均进行系统分级。
elements_zh.main_results: 第 7 天时,与其他组相比,第 3 组在异物感 (P = 0.013)、疼痛 (P = 0.019) 和结膜充血 (P = 0.00) 方面表现出明显更好的结果。第 7 天时,对照组的上皮下浸润 (SEI) (P = 0.0001) 和假膜 (P = 0.035) 数量显着高于其他组。所有组的病毒载量减少情况各不相同,并且无法建立相关性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,PVP-I 1% 和更昔洛韦 0.15% 与地塞米松 0.1% 的组合可显着减轻腺病毒性结膜炎的体征和症状的严重程度。他们还指出,添加地塞米松对于降低 SEI 和假膜的 发病率 是安全有效的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为开发更有效的腺病毒结膜炎 治疗 方案提供信息,特别是在管理症状和预防 SEI 和假膜等并发症方面。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量较小,病毒载量的降低情况各不相同,因此很难建立明确的相关性。由于这些限制,证据的强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:比较三种不同治疗方案在急性腺病毒性结膜炎中的疗效。研究设计:前瞻性随机研究。方法:共纳入65例患者(65只眼),所有患者经巢式聚合酶链反应(PCR)证实为腺病毒性结膜炎。对照组(20只眼)接受卡波姆凝胶治疗,而治疗组(各15只眼)分为:1组:更昔洛韦(0.15%)凝胶每日5次联合地塞米松0.1%每日4次;2组:聚维酮碘(PVP-I)1%每日4次联合地塞米松0.1%每日4次;3组:在标准护理基础上加用PVP-I 1%每日4次、更昔洛韦0.15%每日5次及地塞米松0.1%每日4次。所有患者在症状出现后96小时内入组,各组均接受为期7天的抗病毒药物 治疗治疗。记录入组时、第7天及第14天的临床体征与症状及病毒载量。所有症状与体征均进行分级评估。结果:第7天时,与所有其他组相比,3组在异物感(P=0.013)、疼痛(P=0.019)及结膜充血(P=0.00)方面表现显著更优。对照组在第7天时上皮下浸润(SEIs)数量(P=0.0001)及假膜形成(P=0.035)显著高于其他各组。所有患者在各组中的病毒载量下降情况存在差异,因此无法建立相关性。结论:聚维酮碘(PVP-I)1%联合更昔洛韦0.15%及地塞米松0.1%的组合可显著降低腺病毒性结膜炎的体征与症状严重程度。地塞米松的加用在减少SEIs及假膜形成方面安全且有效。

papers.title: Impact of Human Adenovirus Co-detection on Disease Severity in Children with Medically Attended Acute Respiratory Infections
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Human Adenovirus (HAdV) is frequently identified as a cause of acute respiratory infections (ARIs) in children and often co-detected with other common respiratory viruses. However, the effect of co-detection on disease severity is not well understood. This study aimed to describe the spectrum and frequency of other respiratory viruses co-detected with HAdV and define the impact of co-detection on HAdV disease severity. Methods Children admitted to the hospital or seen in the emergency department with fever and/or respiratory symptoms <14 days duration were enrolled at 7 sites across the US, from 12/01/2016 through 08/31/2023, as part of the CDC-sponsored New Vaccine Surveillance Network (NVSN). Respiratory specimens were systematically obtained and tested for HAdV and other common viral etiologies of ARI. Demographics, clinical characteristics, and disease severity (hospitalization and in-hospital oxygen use) were compared among children with HAdV single detection, HAdV co-detection with other respiratory viral pathogens, and single detection of a non-HAdV virus. Results Of 68,004 children enrolled with a respiratory specimen tested, 4,292 (6.3%) were positive for HAdV; 1,779 (41.4%) of these were HAdV single detections. Human rhinovirus/enterovirus (HRV/EV) (43.1%), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) (14.7%), and parainfluenza virus (PIV) (7.6%) were the most common viruses co-detected with HAdV and selected for further analysis. HAdV co-detection with these 3 viruses was associated with increased odds of hospitalization and in-hospital oxygen use when compared to HAdV single detection. However, the odds of hospitalization and in-hospital oxygen use with HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV single detection were also increased compared to HAdV single detection. Conclusion HAdV co-detection with HRV/EV, RSV, or PIV was associated with increased disease severity when compared to HAdV single detection. However, HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV single detections were also associated with increased severity in comparison to HAdV single detection with these pathogens. Additionally, the increased odds of severe disease seen in HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV single detections was often greater than the increase seen with HAdV co-detection with HRV/EV, RSV, or PIV. This could suggest that the overall severity of these ARIs is being driven primarily by the co-detected viruses, HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV. These results could help guide interpretation of viral testing by clinicians, when multiple viruses are detected. Further research involving asymptomatic and mild HAdV ARI cases, as well as longitudinal studies to determine timing of co-infections, are needed to fully understand the role of HAdV in pediatric ARI of mixed viral etiology.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the impact of co-detection of human adenovirus (HAdV) with other respiratory viruses on disease severity in children with acute respiratory infections (ARIs). The research aimed to understand the association between HAdV and other common respiratory viruses, such as human rhinovirus/enterovirus (HRV/EV), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and parainfluenza virus (PIV), in terms of hospitalization and in-hospital oxygen use. The study was conducted across 7 US sites from 2016 to 2023, involving 68,004 children with respiratory specimens tested. Results showed that HAdV co-detection with HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV was linked to increased odds of severe disease compared to HAdV single detection. However, the increased severity associated with HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV single detection was often greater than that seen with HAdV co-detection. The findings suggest that the overall severity of ARIs may be primarily driven by the co-detected viruses rather than HAdV itself. These results could inform clinical interpretation of viral testing in cases of mixed viral infections. The study does not report specific limitations to the design or evidence strength.

Results Of 68,004 children enrolled with a respiratory specimen tested, 4,292 (6.3%) were positive for HAdV; 1,779 (41.4%) of these were HAdV single detections. Human rhinovirus/enterovirus (HRV/EV) (43.1%), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) (14.7%), and parainfluenza virus (PIV) (7.6%) were the most common viruses co-detected with HAdV and selected for further analysis. HAdV co-detection with these 3 viruses was associated with increased odds of hospitalization and in-hospital oxygen use when compared to HAdV single detection. However, the odds of hospitalization and in-hospital oxygen use with HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV single detection were also increased compared to HAdV single detection. Conclusion HAdV co-detection with HRV/EV, RSV, or PIV was associated with increased disease severity when compared to HAdV single detection. However, HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV single detections were also associated with increased severity in comparison to HAdV single detection with these pathogens. Additionally, the increased odds of severe disease seen in HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV single detections was often greater than the increase seen with HAdV co-detection with HRV/EV, RSV, or PIV. This could suggest that the overall severity of these ARIs is being driven primarily by the co-detected viruses, HRV/EV, RSV, and PIV. These results could help guide interpretation of viral testing by clinicians, when multiple viruses are detected. Further research involving asymptomatic and mild HAdV ARI cases, as well as longitudinal studies to determine timing of co-infections, are needed to fully understand the role of HAdV in pediatric ARI of mixed viral etiology.

papers.title: Presence of human adenovirus 36 in an urban rodent population
papers.abstract: Abstract Adenovirus 36 (AdV36) is a virus associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal infections in humans; interestingly, it also exhibits adipogenic potential, as demonstrated in experimental rodent infections and in human adipose tissue. To detect AdV36 in faecal samples from synanthropic rodents captured in Mexico City, a total of 55 wild rodents (15 Mus musculus and 40 Rattus norvegicus) were trapped in the public park ‘Canal Nacional’ in the southeast of Mexico City. Animals were euthanized, and faecal samples were collected by necropsy. Epidemiological data were also recorded. Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) sequencing, phylogenetic, haplotype network and genetic variability analyses of the E1a and E3 AdV36 genes were performed. The proportion of faecal samples positive for the AdV36 E1a gene was 6.7% in M. musculus and 35% in R. Comparisons by body weight revealed significant differences among R. norvegicus-positive rats. Phylogenetic and haplotype analyses grouped these sequences within the AdV36 cluster and showed shared viral haplotypes with human AdV36 sequences. Our findings show that AdV36 can be detected in the faeces of synanthropic rodents and shares haplotypes with those found in humans, suggesting a zoonotic potential.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the presence of human adenovirus 36 (AdV36) in an urban rodent population, given its association with human respiratory and gastrointestinal infections and its adipogenic potential.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved trapping 55 wild rodents (15 Mus musculus and 40 Rattus norvegicus) in Mexico City's public park ‘Canal Nacional’ to collect faecal samples for AdV36 detection.
analysis.methods: Faecal samples were collected by necropsy, and polymerase chain reaction (PCR) sequencing, phylogenetic, haplotype network and genetic variability analyses of the E1a and E3 AdV36 genes were performed.
analysis.main_results: The proportion of faecal samples positive for the AdV36 E1a gene was 6.7% in Mus musculus and 35% in Rattus norvegicus. Phylogenetic and haplotype analyses grouped these sequences within the AdV36 cluster and showed shared viral haplotypes with human AdV36 sequences.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that AdV36 can be detected in synanthropic rodents and shares haplotypes with human AdV36 sequences, indicating potential zoonotic transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights the need for surveillance of AdV36 in urban rodent populations to better understand its potential role in human disease transmission and to inform public health strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a single urban location and the absence of detailed epidemiological data on human AdV36 infections, which may affect the generalisability of the findings. The evidence is moderate in strength.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the presence of human adenovirus 36 (AdV36) in an urban rodent population in Mexico City. Faecal samples from 55 wild rodents, including 15 Mus musculus and 40 Rattus norvegicus, were collected and analyzed using PCR sequencing and genetic variability assessments. The results showed that 6.7% of Mus musculus samples and 35% of Rattus norvegicus samples were positive for AdV36 E1a gene. Phylogenetic and haplotype analyses revealed that these sequences clustered within the AdV36 group and shared haplotypes with human AdV36 sequences, suggesting zoonotic potential. The study contributes to understanding the ecological distribution of AdV36 and its possible transmission to humans, but its findings are limited by the single urban setting and lack of detailed human epidemiological data, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.methods: 通过尸检收集粪便样本,并采用聚合酶链反应(PCR)测序、系统发育分析、单倍型网络分析及E1a和E3 AdV36基因遗传变异性分析。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果提示,AdV36可在杂居性啮齿动物中检出,并与人类AdV36序列共享单倍型,表明其可能具有人兽共患病潜能。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 本研究强调需在城市啮齿动物种群中开展AdV36监测,以更好地理解其在人类疾病中的潜在作用,并为公共卫生策略提供依据。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the presence of human adenovirus 36 (AdV36) in an urban rodent population, given its association with human respiratory and gastrointestinal infections and its adipogenic potential.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study involved trapping 55 wild rodents (15 Mus musculus and 40 Rattus norvegicus) in Mexico City's public park ‘Canal Nacional’ to collect faecal samples for AdV36 detection.
analysis_en.methods: Faecal samples were collected by necropsy, and polymerase chain reaction (PCR) sequencing, phylogenetic, haplotype network and genetic variability analyses of the E1a and E3 AdV36 genes were performed.
analysis_en.main_results: The proportion of faecal samples positive for the AdV36 E1a gene was 6.7% in Mus musculus and 35% in Rattus norvegicus. Phylogenetic and haplotype analyses grouped these sequences within the AdV36 cluster and showed shared viral haplotypes with human AdV36 sequences.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that AdV36 can be detected in synanthropic rodents and shares haplotypes with human AdV36 sequences, indicating potential zoonotic transmission.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights the need for surveillance of AdV36 in urban rodent populations to better understand its potential role in human disease transmission and to inform public health strategies.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its focus on a single urban location and the absence of detailed epidemiological data on human AdV36 infections, which may affect the generalisability of the findings. The evidence is moderate in strength.

papers.title_zh: 墨西哥城城市啮齿动物种群中腺病毒36的存在
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Adenovirus 36 (AdV36) is a virus associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal infections in humans; interestingly, it also exhibits adipogenic potential, as demonstrated in experimental rodent infections and in human adipose tissue. To detect AdV36 in faecal samples from synanthropic rodents captured in Mexico City, a total of 55 wild rodents (15 Mus musculus and 40 Rattus norvegicus) were trapped in the public park ‘Canal Nacional’ in the southeast of Mexico City. Animals were euthanized, and faecal samples were collected by necropsy. Epidemiological data were also recorded. Polymerase chain reaction (PCR) sequencing, phylogenetic, haplotype network and genetic variability analyses of the E1a and E3 AdV36 genes were performed. The proportion of faecal samples positive for the AdV36 E1a gene was 6.7% in M. musculus and 35% in R. Comparisons by body weight revealed significant differences among R. norvegicus-positive rats. Phylogenetic and haplotype analyses grouped these sequences within the AdV36 cluster and showed shared viral haplotypes with human AdV36 sequences. Our findings show that AdV36 can be detected in the faeces of synanthropic rodents and shares haplotypes with those found in humans, suggesting a zoonotic potential.

papers.title: Respiratory viruses induce ferroptosis-like features in lung epithelial cells
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: During infection, viruses can modulate various regulated cell death (RCD) mechanisms to evade host immunity and enhance replication. However, less is known about how viruses alter the recently discovered RCD ferroptosis, which is characterized by an iron-dependent accumulation of lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial fragmentation. Influenza A virus (IAV) H1N1 and human adenovirus type C5 (HAdV-C5) are two common causes of respiratory infections of the upper and lower respiratory tracts and can lead to severe illness. While IAV has been shown to induce ferroptosis to support its replication, less is known about whether this is also true for HAdV-C5. Here, we perform a comparative study investigating ferroptosis features during IAV H1N1 and HAdV-C5 infections using alveolar (A549) and bronchial (BEAS-2B) epithelial cells. Our data reveal that HAdV-C5, similar to H1N1, induces lipid peroxidation in a time-dependent manner, which is partially suppressed in the presence of the ferroptosis inhibitor ferrostatin-1. Strikingly, HAdV-C5 infections only lead to changes in ferritin protein levels, which is responsible for iron storage, during late stages of infection. Furthermore, both H1N1 and HAdV-C5 infections trigger a profound mitochondrial network remodeling in A549, BEAS-2B, and primary human epithelial cells, comparable to that induced by the ferroptosis inducer RSL3, with effects varying by cell type and infection stage. These findings suggest that HAdV-C5, just like H1N1, can activate ferroptosis-like processes, highlighting a potential role for lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial alterations in adenoviral infection. IMPORTANCE: The findings presented here contribute to a deeper understanding of the molecular mechanisms involved in viral infections of the lung epithelium, particularly in the context of virus-induced lung epithelial cell death, a topic of significant relevance to the area of early viral response mechanisms. By elucidating the role of ferroptosis-like hallmarks encompassing lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial dysfunction, our work may inform the development of new therapeutic strategies aimed at enhancing lung epithelial integrity and barrier function, representing the first layer of defense against human pathogens. The topic is of particular importance given the increasing prevalence of antimicrobial resistance. We believe that our research offers significant insights into the field of viral infections and lung disease and would be of great interest to readers in the field of viral biology and respiratory infections.
authors: Christina HT J. Mol-van der Veen

analysis.research_question_and_background: Viruses can modulate regulated cell death mechanisms to evade host immunity and enhance replication, but the role of ferroptosis in viral infections remains poorly understood. This study investigates whether human adenovirus type C5 (HAdV-C5) induces ferroptosis-like features similar to influenza A virus (IAV) H1N1.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study compares the effects of HAdV-C5 and IAV H1N1 on alveolar (A549) and bronchial (BEAS-2B) epithelial cells, as well as primary human epithelial cells, to assess ferroptosis-like features during infection.
analysis.methods: The researchers used alveolar and bronchial epithelial cells, along with primary human epithelial cells, to investigate ferroptosis-like features induced by HAdV-C5 and IAV H1N1. They assessed lipid peroxidation, mitochondrial network remodeling, and ferritin protein levels during infection.
analysis.main_results: HAdV-C5, like IAV H1N1, induces lipid peroxidation in a time-dependent manner, which is partially suppressed by the ferroptosis inhibitor ferrostatin-1. Additionally, HAdV-C5 infections lead to changes in ferritin protein levels during late stages of infection, while both viruses trigger mitochondrial network remodeling in different cell types and infection stages.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that HAdV-C5, similar to IAV H1N1, can activate ferroptosis-like processes, indicating that lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial alterations may play a role in adenoviral infection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Understanding ferroptosis-like mechanisms in viral infections may inform the development of new therapeutic strategies to enhance lung epithelial integrity and barrier function, which are critical for defense against respiratory pathogens.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro models and does not account for in vivo conditions, which may affect the generalizability of findings. However, the evidence is strong as it directly compares HAdV-C5 and IAV H1N1 using relevant biological markers.

Additionally, HAdV-C5 infections lead to changes in ferritin protein levels during late stages of infection, while both viruses trigger mitochondrial network remodeling in different cell types and infection stages. These findings suggest that HAdV-C5, like IAV H1N1, can activate ferroptosis-like processes, highlighting the potential role of lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial alterations in adenoviral infection. The study contributes to understanding the molecular mechanisms of viral infections of the lung epithelium and may inform the development of new therapeutic strategies. However, the study is limited to in vitro models, which may affect the generalizability of results.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Viruses can modulate regulated cell death mechanisms to evade host immunity and enhance replication, but the role of ferroptosis in viral infections remains poorly understood. This study investigates whether human adenovirus type C5 (HAdV-C5) induces ferroptosis-like features similar to influenza A virus (IAV) H1N1.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study compares the effects of HAdV-C5 and IAV H1N1 on alveolar (A549) and bronchial (BEAS-2B) epithelial cells, as well as primary human epithelial cells, to assess ferroptosis-like features during infection.
analysis_en.methods: The researchers used alveolar and bronchial epithelial cells, along with primary human epithelial cells, to investigate ferroptosis-like features induced by HAdV-C5 and IAV H1N1. They assessed lipid peroxidation, mitochondrial network remodeling, and ferritin protein levels during infection.
analysis_en.main_results: HAdV-C5, like IAV H1N1, induces lipid peroxidation in a time-dependent manner, which is partially suppressed by the ferroptosis inhibitor ferrostatin-1. Additionally, HAdV-C5 infections lead to changes in ferritin protein levels during late stages of infection, while both viruses trigger mitochondrial network remodeling in different cell types and infection stages.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that HAdV-C5, similar to IAV H1N1, can activate ferroptosis-like processes, indicating that lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial alterations may play a role in adenoviral infection.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Understanding ferroptosis-like mechanisms in viral infections may inform the development of new therapeutic strategies to enhance lung epithelial integrity and barrier function, which are critical for defense against respiratory pathogens.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro models and does not account for in vivo conditions, which may affect the generalizability of findings. However, the evidence is strong as it directly compares HAdV-C5 and IAV H1N1 using relevant biological markers.

papers.title_zh: 呼吸道病毒在肺上皮细胞中诱导类似铁死亡的特征
papers.source_body_en: UNLABELLED: During infection, viruses can modulate various regulated cell death (RCD) mechanisms to evade host immunity and enhance replication. However, less is known about how viruses alter the recently discovered RCD ferroptosis, which is characterized by an iron-dependent accumulation of lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial fragmentation. Influenza A virus (IAV) H1N1 and human adenovirus type C5 (HAdV-C5) are two common causes of respiratory infections of the upper and lower respiratory tracts and can lead to severe illness. While IAV has been shown to induce ferroptosis to support its replication, less is known about whether this is also true for HAdV-C5. Here, we perform a comparative study investigating ferroptosis features during IAV H1N1 and HAdV-C5 infections using alveolar (A549) and bronchial (BEAS-2B) epithelial cells. Our data reveal that HAdV-C5, similar to H1N1, induces lipid peroxidation in a time-dependent manner, which is partially suppressed in the presence of the ferroptosis inhibitor ferrostatin-1. Strikingly, HAdV-C5 infections only lead to changes in ferritin protein levels, which is responsible for iron storage, during late stages of infection. Furthermore, both H1N1 and HAdV-C5 infections trigger a profound mitochondrial network remodeling in A549, BEAS-2B, and primary human epithelial cells, comparable to that induced by the ferroptosis inducer RSL3, with effects varying by cell type and infection stage. These findings suggest that HAdV-C5, just like H1N1, can activate ferroptosis-like processes, highlighting a potential role for lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial alterations in adenoviral infection. IMPORTANCE: The findings presented here contribute to a deeper understanding of the molecular mechanisms involved in viral infections of the lung epithelium, particularly in the context of virus-induced lung epithelial cell death, a topic of significant relevance to the area of early viral response mechanisms. By elucidating the role of ferroptosis-like hallmarks encompassing lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial dysfunction, our work may inform the development of new therapeutic strategies aimed at enhancing lung epithelial integrity and barrier function, representing the first layer of defense against human pathogens. The topic is of particular importance given the increasing prevalence of antimicrobial resistance. We believe that our research offers significant insights into the field of viral infections and lung disease and would be of great interest to readers in the field of viral biology and respiratory infections.
papers.abstract_zh: 未标注:在感染过程中,病毒可以调节多种细胞死亡机制(RCD)以逃避宿主免疫并增强复制。然而,关于病毒如何改变最近发现的RCD机制——铁死亡,其特征是铁依赖性的脂质过氧化积累和线粒体碎片化——了解甚少。流感A病毒(IAV)H1N1和人腺病毒类型C5(HAdV-C5)是上呼吸道和下呼吸道感染的常见原因,可能导致严重疾病。虽然IAV已被证明可以诱导铁死亡以支持其复制,但HAdV-C5是否也具有类似作用尚不清楚。在此,我们通过比较研究,利用肺泡(A549)和支气管(BEAS-2B)上皮细胞,探讨HAdV-C5和IAV H1N1感染期间的铁死亡特征。我们的数据表明,HAdV-C5与H1N1类似,在感染过程中以时间依赖性方式诱导脂质过氧化,这种效应在存在铁死亡抑制剂ferrostatin-1的情况下部分被抑制。值得注意的是,HAdV-C5感染仅在感染晚期导致铁蛋白蛋白水平的变化,而铁蛋白是负责铁储存的。此外,H1N1和HAdV-C5感染均在A549、BEAS-2B和原代人上皮细胞中引发显著的线粒体网络重塑,这种效应与铁死亡诱导剂RSL3诱导的类似,但其影响因细胞类型和感染阶段而异。这些发现表明,HAdV-C5与H1N1类似,可以激活类似铁死亡的过程,突显了脂质过氧化和线粒体改变在腺病毒感染中的潜在作用。重要性:本研究的结果有助于更深入地理解病毒在肺上皮细胞感染中的分子机制,特别是在病毒诱导的肺上皮细胞死亡这一主题上,这对早期病毒反应机制的研究具有重要意义。通过阐明包括脂质过氧化和线粒体功能障碍在内的类似铁死亡特征的作用,我们的研究可能为开发新的治疗策略提供信息,以增强肺上皮的完整性与屏障功能,这代表了对抗人类病原体的第一道防线。该主题尤为重要,鉴于抗微生物耐药性的不断增加。我们认为,我们的研究为病毒性感染和肺病领域提供了重要的见解,对病毒生物学和呼吸道感染领域的读者具有极大的兴趣。

papers.title: A field-deployable immunofluorescence chip for adenovirus monitoring in groundwater systems
papers.abstract: Rapid field detection of human adenoviruses in groundwater remains a critical technological gap, particularly for riverbank filtration systems, exposed to extreme weather and contamination events. Here, we present the VIRUMEX chip, a field-deployable platform that captures and detects adenovirus proteins through popular immunofluorescence mechanism using antibody-functionalized 3D Sepharose beads integrated into a disposable flow-through microfluidic cartridge. Powered by a compact peristaltic pump, the system autonomously processes groundwater and yields fluorescence-based readouts in light intensity unit (LIU) within 4-8 h, enabling near-real time semi-quantitative pathogen surveillance. Laboratory tests produced a clear detectable signal at 0.129 ng/mL (1000 LIU) for adenovirus hexon protein, and field deployment in the Erpe River catchment produced above-background fluorescence (800 LIU) in river water, providing proof-of-concept evidence with positive signal under real riverbank filtration conditions, while groundwater samples remained negative under the tested conditions. By providing an on-site, rapid, and operationally simple detection method, the VIRUMEX chip provides an additional on-site virus screening prototype alongside qPCR and isothermal approaches and offers a promising prototype for integrating virus monitoring into groundwater safety frameworks which needs some further optimizations before it can be regarded as a fully validated detection tool.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces the VIRUMEX chip, a field-deployable platform for detecting human adenoviruses in groundwater systems. The research addresses the critical technological gap in rapid pathogen surveillance, particularly for riverbank filtration systems vulnerable to contamination. The chip uses immunofluorescence with antibody-functionalized 3D Sepharose beads in a disposable microfluidic cartridge, powered by a compact peristaltic pump, to autonomously process groundwater and produce fluorescence-based readouts in light intensity units (LIU) within 4-8 hours. Laboratory tests showed a detectable signal at 0.129 ng/mL (1000 LIU) for adenovirus hexon protein, while field deployment in the Erpe River catchment detected above-background fluorescence (800 LIU) in river water, indicating a positive signal under real conditions. Groundwater samples remained negative. The VIRUMEX chip is presented as a promising addition to existing methods like qPCR and isothermal approaches for virus monitoring in groundwater safety frameworks, though further optimizations are needed for full validation. The study's limitations include the need for additional refinements to ensure reliability and accuracy in real-world applications.

papers.title: The characterization of a rhamnosylated triterpenic saponin from Quillaja saponaria Mol. reveals novel adjuvant, antibacterial, antiviral, antifungal and antiproliferative properties
papers.abstract: Quillaja: is an abundant source of triterpenic saponins, glycosides with immunostimulant properties, currently employed as vaccine adjuvants. Although current research and commercial applications have focused on the most abundant saponins in Quillaja extracts (QS-7, QS-17, QS-18 and QS-21), the vast chemical variety in Quillaja saponins remains largely unexplored. The discovery of new saponins suited as vaccine adjuvants would open the door to a wider supply of adjuvants in the future. This paper describes the isolation and chemical characterization of Saponin FR, a new saponin fraction purified from extracts of a Quillaja specimen depleted of traditional saponins QS-7, QS-17, QS-18 and QS-21. The main component of this fraction is a bidesmosidic glycoside of quillaic acid substituted at C-3 and C-28 (molecular mass 2003.93 Da). Mass and NMR spectroscopies characterization revealed a structure similar to QS-21 where the 3-O-[β-d-xylopyranosyl-(1→3)-[β-d-galactopyranosyl-(1→2)]-β-d-glucuronopyranoside] is replaced by a 3-O-[α-l-rhamnopyranosyl-(1→3)-[β-d-galactopyranosyl-(1→2)]-β-d-glucuronopyranoside] substituent at position C3. Tests in mice immunized with ovalbumin demonstrated that Saponin FR induces a tenfold increase of the total immunoglobulin titer compared to the antigen control without Saponin FR (mostly IgG1 type). Cytokine analysis of serum samples showed a significant increase of IFN-γ upon immunization with Saponin FR. By contrast the production of cytokines IL-4, IL-6 and IL-10 was not observed, suggesting a pro-inflammatory Th1 response. Regarding the antimicrobial effect of Saponin FR, S. aureus ATCC25923 and K. pneumoniae ATCC 1705 were susceptible to concentrations as low as 0.12 μM and the same effect was observed against a clinical isolate of C. Saponin FR was also effective as antiviral agent evaluated in in vitro assays using HeLa cells infected with the human adenovirus 5 (VR-5), significantly reducing its infectivity at concentrations as low as 1 nM in in vitro assays. Finally, Saponin FR showed remarkable antiproliferative activity against gastric (AGS 1739) and cervix (HeLa CRM-CCL-2) adenocarcinoma cell lines with half maximal inhibitory concentrations (IC 50 ) of 2.9 and 2.6 μM, respectively. Overall, Saponin FR broadens the spectrum of Quillaja saponins for new vaccine adjuvant, antimicrobial, antiviral and antitumoral formulations with potential clinical application.

analysis.methods: The saponin fraction was isolated and characterized using mass and NMR spectroscopies. In vivo immunization tests were conducted on mice with ovalbumin, and in vitro assays were performed on HeLa cells infected with human adenovirus 5 (VR-5) to assess antiviral activity.

analysis.summary_en: This study characterizes a new saponin fraction (Saponin FR) from Quillaja saponaria Mol. depleted of traditional saponins. It reveals that Saponin FR has a structure similar to QS-21 but with a rhamnopyranosyl substituent at position C3. In mice immunized with ovalbumin, Saponin FR significantly increased total immunoglobulin titer and induced a pro-inflammatory Th1 response, as evidenced by elevated IFN-γ levels. In vitro tests showed that Saponin FR effectively reduced the infectivity of human adenovirus 5 (VR-5) at low concentrations. These findings suggest that Saponin FR could serve as a novel adjuvant and antiviral agent, broadening the potential applications of Quillaja saponins. However, the study is limited to animal and in vitro models, and further clinical validation is needed. The evidence is moderate in strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探索从Quillaja saponaria Mol.中提取的新皂苷作为疫苗佐剂、抗菌、抗病毒药物、抗真菌和抗增殖剂的潜力,鉴于Quillaja皂苷的广泛化学多样性尚未被充分探索。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及从缺乏传统皂苷QS-7、QS-17、QS-18和QS-21的Quillaja saponaria Mol.提取物中分离并化学表征新的皂苷组分(Saponin FR)。此外,还包括使用卵白蛋白免疫的小鼠和感染人腺病毒 5(VR-5)的HeLa细胞进行的体外和体内测试。
elements_zh.methods: 使用质谱和核磁共振(NMR)光谱对皂苷组分进行了分离和化学表征。在体内免疫实验中,对用卵白蛋白免疫的小鼠进行了测试,而在体外实验中,对感染人腺病毒 5(VR-5)的HeLa细胞进行了测试,以评估抗病毒药物活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 质谱和核磁共振(NMR)光谱显示,Saponin FR的结构与QS-21相似,但在C3位具有半乳糖基取代基。在用卵白蛋白免疫的小鼠中,Saponin FR使总免疫球蛋白滴度增加了十倍,与不含Saponin FR的抗原对照组相比。细胞因子分析显示IFN-γ显著增加,而IL-4、IL-6和IL-10未被观察到。此外,Saponin FR在1 nM的浓度下显著降低了人腺病毒 5(VR-5)的感染性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,Saponin FR诱导了促炎的Th1免疫应答,并表现出对人腺病毒 5(VR-5)的抗病毒药物活性,突显了其作为新型佐剂和抗病毒药物剂的潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为开发新的疫苗佐剂和抗病毒药物制剂提供了见解,这些制剂可能在临床环境中用于人腺病毒感染的治疗。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外和体内模型,且证据基于单一皂苷组分。结果具有前景,但需要在临床试验中进一步验证。证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: Quillaja是一种丰富的三萜皂苷来源,这些皂苷是具有免疫刺激作用的糖苷,目前被用作疫苗佐剂。尽管当前的研究和商业应用主要集中在Quillaja提取物中最丰富的皂苷(QS-7、QS-17、QS-18和QS-21)上,但Quillaja皂苷的广泛化学多样性仍 largely unexplored。发现新的适合作为疫苗佐剂的皂苷将为未来佐剂的广泛供应打开大门。本文描述了从缺乏传统皂苷QS-7、QS-17、QS-18和QS-21的Quillaja样本提取物中分离并化学表征的新皂苷组分Saponin FR。该组分的主要成分是一种在C-3和C-28位被取代的 quillaic 酸的双糖苷(分子质量为2003.93 Da)。通过质谱和核磁共振(NMR)光谱表征,发现其结构与QS-21相似,但C3位的取代基为3-O-[α-l-半乳糖基-(1→3)-[β-d-葡萄糖基-(1→2)]-β-d-葡萄糖醛酸基],而非QS-21中的3-O-[β-d-木糖基-(1→3)-[β-d-葡萄糖基-(1→2)]-β-d-葡萄糖醛酸基]。在用卵白蛋白免疫的小鼠实验中,Saponin FR使总免疫球蛋白滴度增加了十倍,与不含Saponin FR的抗原对照组(主要为IgG1型)相比。血清样本的细胞因子分析显示,使用Saponin FR免疫后IFN-γ显著增加,而IL-4、IL-6和IL-10未被观察到,这表明其诱导了促炎的Th1免疫应答。关于Saponin FR的抗菌作用,S. aureus ATCC25923和K. pneumoniae ATCC 1705在0.12 μM的浓度下对Saponin FR敏感,且在针对C. 的临床分离株中也观察到了相同的效果。Saponin FR在体外实验中也显示出作为抗病毒药物剂的活性,使用HeLa细胞感染人腺病毒 5(VR-5)进行评估,其在1 nM的浓度下显著降低了感染性。最后,Saponin FR在胃腺癌(AGS 1739)和宫颈腺癌(HeLa CRM-CCL-2)细胞系中表现出显著的抗增殖活性,其半数抑制浓度(IC 50)分别为2.9和2.6 μM。总体而言,Saponin FR拓宽了Quillaja皂苷在新型疫苗佐剂、抗菌、抗病毒药物和抗肿瘤制剂中的应用前景,具有潜在的临床应用价值。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探索从Quillaja saponaria Mol.中提取的新皂苷作为疫苗佐剂、抗菌、抗病毒药物、抗真菌和抗增殖剂的潜力,鉴于Quillaja皂苷的广泛化学多样性尚未被充分探索。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及从缺乏传统皂苷QS-7、QS-17、QS-18和QS-21的Quillaja saponaria Mol.提取物中分离并化学表征新的皂苷组分(Saponin FR)。此外,还包括使用卵白蛋白免疫的小鼠和感染人腺病毒 5(VR-5)的HeLa细胞进行的体外和体内测试。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用质谱和核磁共振(NMR)光谱对皂苷组分进行了分离和化学表征。在体内免疫实验中,对用卵白蛋白免疫的小鼠进行了测试,而在体外实验中,对感染人腺病毒 5(VR-5)的HeLa细胞进行了测试,以评估抗病毒药物活性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 质谱和核磁共振(NMR)光谱显示,Saponin FR的结构与QS-21相似,但在C3位具有半乳糖基取代基。在用卵白蛋白免疫的小鼠中,Saponin FR使总免疫球蛋白滴度增加了十倍,与不含Saponin FR的抗原对照组相比。细胞因子分析显示IFN-γ显著增加,而IL-4、IL-6和IL-10未被观察到。此外,Saponin FR在1 nM的浓度下显著降低了人腺病毒 5(VR-5)的感染性。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,Saponin FR诱导了促炎的Th1免疫应答,并表现出对人腺病毒 5(VR-5)的抗病毒药物活性,突显了其作为新型佐剂和抗病毒药物剂的潜力。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果为开发新的疫苗佐剂和抗病毒药物制剂提供了见解,这些制剂可能在临床环境中用于人腺病毒感染的治疗。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于体外和体内模型,且证据基于单一皂苷组分。结果具有前景,但需要在临床试验中进一步验证。证据强度中等。

papers.full_text: Abstract Background Conjunctivitis remains one of the most common ocular conditions affecting paediatric and adult populations globally. South and Southeast Asia have experienced unprecedented seasonal surges in conjunctivitis cases, with tens of thousands of cases occurring over short periods, particularly during monsoon and pre-monsoon seasons. Classification & Pathophysiology Conjunctivitis is classified into infectious causes (viral, bacterial, and chlamydial) and non-infectious causes (allergic, toxic, cicatricial, and immune-mediated). Viral conjunctivitis accounts for the majority of cases. Adenovirus's ability to survive on fomites for weeks, combined with pre-symptomatic shedding and low infectious dose, facilitates rapid community spread in overcrowded, poorly sanitized environments. Clinical Management Diagnosis requires aetiology-guided differentiation based on discharge patterns, associated symptoms, and lymph-node findings. Most viral cases are self-limiting and managed supportively. Antibiotic stewardship is critical for bacterial infections, while allergic conjunctivitis requires allergen avoidance and targeted pharmacotherapy. Contact-lens wearers demand careful evaluation for corneal involvement. Public Health Implications Effective outbreak control requires multifaceted interventions: rigorous hand hygiene, school-based screening,coordinated community awareness campaigns, and systematic surveillance. Preventing unnecessary antibiotic and corticosteroid use reduces complications and antimicrobial resistance. Conclusion Structured, evidence-based prevention coupled with judicious clinical management offer the most effective means of reducing transmission and complications across vulnerable populations. Highlights - Conjunctivitis has infectious (viral, bacterial, chlamydial) and non-infectious (allergic, toxic, cicatricial, immune-mediated) causes. - South and Southeast Asia experience large, recurrent seasonal outbreaks concentrated in humid, densely populated urban areas. - Adenoviral stability on fomites, low infectious dose, and pre-symptomatic shedding explain rapid viral spread. - Aetiology-guided management and antibiotic stewardship reduce complications and antimicrobial resistance. - Structured public health measures—infection control, school-based screening, and community awareness—are central to outbreak control. Data availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. References - Benson S, Gurnani B, Hashmi MF, Price KL (2022) Conjunctivitis (Nursing). In: StatPearls. StatPearls Publishing, Treasure Island (FL) - Azari AA, Barney NP (2013) Conjunctivitis: a systematic review of diagnosis and treatment. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract Background Conjunctivitis remains one of the most common ocular conditions affecting paediatric and adult populations globally. South and Southeast Asia have experienced unprecedented seasonal surges in conjunctivitis cases, with tens of thousands of cases occurring over short periods, particularly during monsoon and pre-monsoon seasons. Classification & Pathophysiology Conjunctivitis is classified into infectious causes (viral, bacterial, and chlamydial) and non-infectious causes (allergic, toxic, cicatricial, and immune-mediated). Viral conjunctivitis accounts for the majority of cases. Adenovirus's ability to survive on fomites for weeks, combined with pre-symptomatic shedding and low infectious dose, facilitates rapid community spread in overcrowded, poorly sanitized environments. Clinical Management Diagnosis requires aetiology-guided differentiation based on discharge patterns, associated symptoms, and lymph-node findings. Most viral cases are self-limiting and managed supportively. Antibiotic stewardship is critical for bacterial infections, while allergic conjunctivitis requires allergen avoidance and targeted pharmacotherapy. Contact-lens wearers demand careful evaluation for corneal involvement. Public Health Implications Effective outbreak control requires multifaceted interventions: rigorous hand hygiene, school-based screening,coordinated community awareness campaigns, and systematic surveillance. Preventing unnecessary antibiotic and corticosteroid use reduces complications and antimicrobial resistance. Conclusion Structured, evidence-based prevention coupled with judicious clinical management offer the most effective means of reducing transmission and complications across vulnerable populations. Highlights - Conjunctivitis has infectious (viral, bacterial, chlamydial) and non-infectious (allergic, toxic, cicatricial, immune-mediated) causes. - South and Southeast Asia experience large, recurrent seasonal outbreaks concentrated in humid, densely populated urban areas. - Adenoviral stability on fomites, low infectious dose, and pre-symptomatic shedding explain rapid viral spread. - Aetiology-guided management and antibiotic stewardship reduce complications and antimicrobial resistance. - Structured public health measures—infection control, school-based screening, and community awareness—are central to outbreak control. papers.title_original: Asia’s eye health challenge: unravelling the spread and solutions for conjunctivitis

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the growing public health challenge of conjunctivitis in Asia, particularly focusing on its seasonal surges and the need for targeted prevention and management strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of existing literature and public health data, focusing on South and Southeast Asia, where large seasonal outbreaks of conjunctivitis occur in humid, densely populated urban areas.
analysis.methods: The methods involved a comprehensive analysis of clinical and epidemiological data, including the classification of conjunctivitis into infectious and non-infectious causes, and the identification of key factors contributing to its spread.
analysis.main_results: The study found that viral conjunctivitis accounts for the majority of cases, with adenovirus being a significant contributor. Adenovirus's ability to survive on fomites for weeks, combined with pre-symptomatic shedding and low infectious dose, facilitates rapid community spread.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that structured, evidence-based prevention strategies are essential for reducing transmission and complications of conjunctivitis, particularly in vulnerable populations.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for improved infection control, community awareness, and targeted clinical management to reduce the burden of conjunctivitis in Asia.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on existing literature and does not include new data, which limits its ability to provide definitive conclusions. However, the evidence is strong and grounded in well-established epidemiological and clinical observations.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the public health challenge of conjunctivitis in Asia, highlighting its seasonal surges and the need for effective prevention and management strategies. It emphasizes the role of viral causes, particularly adenovirus, in the spread of the disease. The authors suggest that structured, evidence-based prevention and aetiology-guided clinical management are key to reducing transmission and complications. While the study is based on existing literature and lacks new data, its findings are supported by strong epidemiological and clinical evidence. The implications for public health include the implementation of infection control measures, community awareness campaigns, and antibiotic stewardship to mitigate the impact of conjunctivitis in vulnerable populations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在应对亚洲结膜炎这一日益严峻的公共卫生挑战,重点关注其季节性激增及针对性预防与管理策略的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究为现有文献与公共卫生数据的综述,重点关注南亚与东南亚地区,该地区在潮湿、人口密集的城市地区会出现大规模季节性 暴发。
elements_zh.methods: 研究方法包括对临床与流行病学数据的综合分析,包括将结膜炎分类为感染性与非感染性病因,并识别促进其传播的关键因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现病毒性结膜炎占大多数病例,其中腺病毒是重要贡献者。腺病毒可在污染物上存活数周,结合无症状前期排毒与低感染剂量,促进了社区的快速传播。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,结构化、循证预防策略对于减少 传播 及结膜炎并发症至关重要,尤其是在脆弱人群中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为改善感染控制、社区意识与针对性临床管理提供依据,以减轻亚洲结膜炎负担。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于现有文献,未纳入新数据,因此其提供确定性结论的能力有限。然而,证据基于公认的流行病学与临床观察,具有较强说服力。

analysis_en.methods: The methods involved a comprehensive analysis of clinical and epidemiological data, including the classification of conjunctivitis into infectious and non-infectious causes, and the identification of key factors contributing to its spread.
analysis_en.main_results: The study found that viral conjunctivitis accounts for the majority of cases, with adenovirus being a significant contributor. Adenovirus's ability to survive on fomites for weeks, combined with pre-symptomatic shedding and low infectious dose, facilitates rapid community spread.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that structured, evidence-based prevention strategies are essential for reducing transmission and complications of conjunctivitis, particularly in vulnerable populations.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for improved infection control, community awareness, and targeted clinical management to reduce the burden of conjunctivitis in Asia.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on existing literature and does not include new data, which limits its ability to provide definitive conclusions. However, the evidence is strong and grounded in well-established epidemiological and clinical observations.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在应对亚洲结膜炎这一日益严峻的公共卫生挑战,重点关注其季节性激增及针对性预防与管理策略的需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究为现有文献与公共卫生数据的综述,重点关注南亚与东南亚地区,该地区在潮湿、人口密集的城市地区会出现大规模季节性 暴发。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究方法包括对临床与流行病学数据的综合分析,包括将结膜炎分类为感染性与非感染性病因,并识别促进其传播的关键因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究发现病毒性结膜炎占大多数病例,其中腺病毒是重要贡献者。腺病毒可在污染物上存活数周,结合无症状前期排毒与低感染剂量,促进了社区的快速传播。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,结构化、循证预防策略对于减少 传播 及结膜炎并发症至关重要,尤其是在脆弱人群中。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为改善感染控制、社区意识与针对性临床管理提供依据,以减轻亚洲结膜炎负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究基于现有文献,未纳入新数据,因此其提供确定性结论的能力有限。然而,证据基于公认的流行病学与临床观察,具有较强说服力。
